name: LELO Sona 2 Cruise
summary: Luxury sonic-wave clitoral massager using LELO's SenSonic broad acoustic pulses and Cruise Control power reserve when pressed firmly.
ranking_rationale: Smooth body-safe silicone, broad sonic resonance rather than tight pinpoint suction, and Cruise Control anti-stall engineering shine, though hard rims divide taste.

pricing.notes: Check official LELO store for current pricing.

pros: Cruise Control boosts motor power automatically when pressed firmly
Single-piece ultra-smooth silicone body cleans quickly and is IPX7 waterproof
Broader acoustic wave feel reaches deeper tissue than narrow air nozzles
cons: Proprietary DC barrel charger instead of standard USB-C
Higher intensity sonic rattle is less stealthy than Womanizer Smart Silence
